Associate Product Manager - Driver Marketplace
Uber
Gurugram, Haryana, India (Hybrid)

About the Job:
Design matching algorithms, driver incentives, and pricing models for rides in South Asia.

Responsibilities:
• Author PRDs for driver onboarding, verification, and dispatch efficiency.
• Run A/B testing on pricing models and track driver retention.
• Collaborate with operations teams across 20+ Indian cities.

Requirements:
• 1-3 years of product management or analytical experience.
• Degree from Tier-1 engineering colleges (IIT/BITS/NIT) preferred.
• High analytical acumen with SQL and Python.
